items.description: Translation of police report Spanish to English, 68 lines
items.rationale: Claim substantiation cost excluded under 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f); translation is the policyholder's own expense.
Provider's working materials raised alongside an excluded translation charge; excluded under 7.1.8(e) and (f).

items.description: Compensation for robbery damage (watch and cash)
items.rationale: Taking by force is covered under 2.3.1. Watch is capped at the valuables per-item sub-limit of EUR 2,500 (4.2.2, no schedule); cash over EUR 800 is capped at EUR 500 (4.2.3). Total 3,000 is within the 5,000 outside-premises limit; less the EUR 50 deductible it would be 2,950. Bundled line under 7.1.10.
